data.function: P2 report: clamp level against the switch alternates
data.ruling: The refutation stands. The clamp levels in the claim match the datasheets: SN74LVC244A VO in the high or low state is -0.5 to VCC + 0.5 V, which is 3.70 V at VCC 3.201 V. SN74CBTLV3126 VI is 4.6 V. TC7MBL3126CFT VS is -0.5 to VCC + 0.5 V with the switch on and -0.5 to 4.6 V with the switch off or VCC at 0 V. The fault current the claim gives for the SN74LVC244A outputs is wrong. The claim uses 18.5 mA at 275 Ohm. The 275 Ohm bound comes from the RP2354B pad's 12 mA drive and applies only to the pad-driven lines through the switch: the 4 multiprotocol ports and the UART socket. The SN74LVC244A drives the 16 PWM lines. The lower bound for those lines is 142 Ohm (3.4 V / 24 mA, from the V75 found value and the 'series resistance on buffered lines' row of 'series resistance and clamps'). At that bound a short to 8.7 V (F16's HV ceiling) puts (8.7 - 3.6) / 142 = 35.9 mA into the clamp, about twice the current the claim specifies. A clamp specified at 18.5 mA is therefore specified at the wrong operating point for the SN74LVC244A lines. The claim's 18.5 mA at 275 Ohm is right for the switch alternates only. The verifier's second point also holds against the protection the claim implies. With the SN74LVC244A output driving low into the 8.7 V short, the pin sits near VOL and the clamp does not conduct. The output then sinks (8.7 - 0.55) / 142 = 57.4 mA, using VOL 0.55 V, which the datasheet specifies at 24 mA and not at 57 mA. With VOL at 0 V it sinks 61.3 mA. Either value is above the IO continuous output current rating of +-50 mA. A clamp level alone does not keep an SN74LVC244A output within its ratings in that fault. The ruling is about this function's requirement values, not the part, so its scope is function.
data.evidence: SCAS414AG (revised June 2026) section 5.1: VO applied to any output in the high or low state -0.5 to VCC + 0.5 V; IO continuous output current +-50 mA; continuous current through VCC or GND +-100 mA. Section 5.5: VOL max 0.55 V at IOL 24 mA, VCC 3 V (-40 to +85 C). SCDS038N (revised July 2026) section 5.1: VI -0.5 to 4.6 V; II/O continuous channel current 128 mA. TC7MBL3125CFT/TC7MBL3126CFT Rev.7.0.A section 9: VS -0.5 to 4.6 V with VCC 0 V or the switch off, -0.5 to VCC + 0.5 V with the switch on; IS 50 mA. Nexperia 74CBTLV3126 Rev. 7 (11 April 2024) Table 4: VSW -0.5 to VCC + 0.5 V in enable and disable mode; ISW +-128 mA. Requirement rows: FU-A2 004-P2-R4.json, V75 found value, which the FU-A3 P2 carries as the 'series resistance and clamps' rows. Those rows give at least 275 Ohm on the 4 multiprotocol lines and the UART socket (3.3 V / 12 mA) and at least 142 Ohm on the 16 PWM lines (3.4 V / 24 mA, SCAS414AG 5.3). The gated output buffer's 'lines' row names the 16 PWM ports. selection.json has SN74LVC244APWR as rank 1 of R4's gated output buffer. Derived: (8.7 - 3.6) / 142 = 35.9 mA; (8.7 - 3.6) / 275 = 18.5 mA; (8.7 - 0.55) / 142 = 57.4 mA, which exceeds the 50 mA IO rating.
